tables.heading_context: ## Coral Bleaching: The Breakdown of Symbiosis
rows: First global bleaching
El Niño; 16% of global coral died
Second global bleaching
Widespread Caribbean/Indo-Pacific mortality
Third global bleaching
Largest recorded; ~50% of Great Barrier Reef bleached
Fourth global bleaching
Confirmed by NOAA — all major reef systems affected
What gives coral its color?
Zooxanthellae (brown) + coral fluorescent proteins (vivid colors)
Why is bleached coral white?
Transparent tissue over white CaCO₃ skeleton; zooxanthellae expelled
What temperature triggers bleaching?
Local SST + 1-2°C sustained over ~4 weeks
How do corals get most of their energy?
Photosynthate from zooxanthellae (90-99%)
Why do reefs have high diversity?
Intermediate disturbance + tight nutrient recycling
What is the largest coral structure?
Great Barrier Reef: ~344,400 km², visible from space
What is the coral triangle?
Indo-Pacific region (Indonesia, Philippines, PNG) — maximum marine biodiversity
Why does ocean acidification threaten corals?
Reduces CO₃²⁻ → lowers aragonite saturation → slows calcification
What do parrotfish do to reefs?
Graze coral algae AND scrape/digest coral → produce reef sand
